items.title: Tom Porrello interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, March 6, 2023
items.q: And we did the “Tom Jones Show” that was Audino, Ray Triscari, Jimmy Zito and myself.

ctx.x: That was the last of the live shows by the way, no fixes. No fixes. That and then Pat Paulson “Half a Comedy Hour” it was called. And that was a small band. That was two trumpets, myself and Conte Candoli. It was an all-star band, it really was. Ray Brown

was playing bass. Jack Sperling was playing drums, I forget who the saxophone player was. Did that. And the reason I moved to L.A., Vic Damone — I had a lot of exposure with Vic Damone. They wrote a couple of charts where I had a chance to play — be featured like. And the conductor for “Hollywood Palace” happened to be in town and came to that show and he heard me play and he asked me if I’d like to come down and be lead trumpet player at “Hollywood Palace.” And I talked to Vic and I told Vic about it and Vic…
